title: CORD: Conflict-Aware Optimization for Joint RL and Distillation in Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.29965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Joint reinforcement learning and self-distillation combines task rewards with dense teacher guidance for agent training, but their gradients can partly cancel. A mixing coefficient controls relative scale without selectively removing opposing components. We present CORD, a general framework for conflict-aware optimization of two objectives. CORD separates the choice of protected objective from the condition that triggers projection, and combines the gradients once per optimizer mini-batch. A nearest-point formulation yields a closed-form update and characterizes its first-order effect on the protected objective before optimizer transformations. Gradient diagnostics connect conflict in agent training to lost local optimization progress and motivate selective correction. As a gradient-combination mechanism, CORD can be added to different joint training recipes while retaining their objectives. Across three such recipes, it improves ALFWorl

translated_title: CORD：面向智能体强化学习与蒸馏联合训练的冲突感知优化方法
translated_abstract: 将强化学习与自蒸馏相结合的联合训练方法，把任务奖励与稠密的教师指导信号结合起来用于智能体训练，但二者的梯度可能部分相互抵消。混合系数只能控制两种目标的相对规模，却无法有选择地去除相互对抗的分量。我们提出了CORD，一个面向双目标冲突感知优化的通用框架。CORD将“受保护目标”的选择与“触发投影”的条件相互解耦，并在每个优化器小批次中仅进行一次梯度组合。基于最近点形式的表述，CORD给出了闭式更新规则，并在优化器变换之前刻画了其对受保护目标的一阶效应。梯度诊断方法将智能体训练中的梯度冲突与局部优化进展的损失联系起来，从而支持有选择性的修正。作为一种梯度组合机制，CORD可以嵌入到不同的联合训练方案中，同时保留它们各自的目标。在三种此类方案中，CORD在ALFWorld等任务上均带来了性能提升……
tldr: 提出CORD冲突感知优化框架，通过最近点投影以闭式更新有选择地消除强化学习与蒸馏目标间相互抵消的梯度分量，从而在多种智能体联合训练方案中提升训练效果。
